from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import uuid
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
BASE = ROOT / "work/ceres-v3/05"
FREEZE = BASE / "candidate-v3/baseline.json"
OLD = BASE / "evidence/controlled-20261005T213814Z-e9eee78c"
OLD_MAP = json.loads((OLD / "core-001/case-node-map.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
MANIFEST = json.loads(FREEZE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
EXPECTED_ZIP = "057c8503f97e49da9425e07294bfdaf5af3d8cb46c20fb1814eac0f202131b69"
PYTHON = ROOT / "backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"
BACKEND = ROOT / "backend"
DB = ROOT / "data/sale_guide.db"
TRACE_PLUGIN = OLD / "core-001"
EXPECTED_HEAD = "5462e999d583a9bab6147d0b4141d98321f3cc92"


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def dump(path: Path, value: object) -> None:
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def source_hashes() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {p: sha(ROOT / p) for p in MANIFEST["sha256"]}


run_dir = BASE / "evidence" / f"candidate-v3-{datetime.now(timezone.utc):%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
run_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
candidate_zip = BASE / "candidate-v3/source.zip"
head = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
initial = source_hashes()
db_hash = sha(DB)
preflight = {
    "head": head,
    "expected_head": EXPECTED_HEAD,
    "candidate_zip_sha256": sha(candidate_zip),
    "expected_candidate_zip_sha256": EXPECTED_ZIP,
    "manifest_paths": len(MANIFEST["sha256"]),
    "expected_manifest_paths": MANIFEST["source_path_count"],
    "current_matches_manifest": initial == MANIFEST["sha256"],
    "mismatches": [p for p in initial if initial[p] != MANIFEST["sha256"][p]],
    "source_catalog_sha256": db_hash,
    "expected_source_catalog_sha256": MANIFEST["source_catalog"]["sha256"],
}
dump(run_dir / "candidate-freeze-check.json", preflight)
if (head != EXPECTED_HEAD or preflight["candidate_zip_sha256"] != EXPECTED_ZIP
        or len(initial) != 305 or not preflight["current_matches_manifest"]
        or db_hash != MANIFEST["source_catalog"]["sha256"]):
    print(json.dumps({"run_dir": str(run_dir), "preflight": preflight}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(2)

plugin_dir = run_dir / "plugins"
plugin_dir.mkdir()
(plugin_dir / "ceres_failure_inject.py").write_text(r'''"""Controlled public TestClient.send and model HTTP boundaries."""
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path

LOG = Path(os.environ["CERES_FAILURE_BOUNDARY_LOG"])
TARGET = re.compile(r"/api/v1/chat/openings/[^/]+/turns/stream\Z")

def _record(kind, request):
    with LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps({"kind": kind, "host": request.url.host,
                                 "method": request.method, "path": request.url.path}) + "\n")

def pytest_runtest_setup(item):
    import httpx
    import httpx2
    from openai import DefaultHttpxClient
    from starlette.testclient import TestClient
    testclient_original = TestClient.send
    def testclient_boundary(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        if request.url.host == "testserver":
            if TARGET.fullmatch(request.url.path):
                _record("injected", request)
                raise httpx2.ConnectError("controlled recording probe", request=request)
            _record("testserver-allowed", request)
            return testclient_original(self, request, *args, **kwargs)
        _record("external-blocked", request)
        raise httpx2.ConnectError("controlled external boundary block", request=request)
    TestClient.send = testclient_boundary
    classes = (httpx.Client, httpx2.Client, DefaultHttpxClient)
    originals = [(cls, cls.send) for cls in classes]
    for cls, original in originals:
        def boundary(self, request, *args, _original=original, **kwargs):
            if request.url.host == "testserver":
                return _original(self, request, *args, **kwargs)
            _record("external-blocked", request)
            error = httpx2.ConnectError if isinstance(request, httpx2.Request) else httpx.ConnectError
            raise error("controlled external boundary block", request=request)
        setattr(cls, "send", boundary)
''', encoding="utf-8")

all_core_nodes = OLD_MAP["actual_collected_nodes"]
if len(all_core_nodes) != 16:
    raise SystemExit(f"expected 16 frozen core nodes, got {len(all_core_nodes)}")

controlled = {
    "LLM_MODE": "live", "BUSINESS_DATA_MODE": "demo",
    "OPENAI_BASE_URL": "http://127.0.0.1:9/v1", "OPENAI_API_KEY": "codex-test-key",
    "LLM_MODEL": "codex-test-model", "KEV_BASE_URL": "http://127.0.0.1:9",
    "MEMORY_MODEL": "", "RETRIEVAL_MODE": "hybrid", "RETRIEVAL_INDEX_DIR": "",
    "EMBEDDING_BASE_URL": "http://127.0.0.1:9/v1", "EMBEDDING_API_KEY": "codex-test-key",
    "EMBEDDING_MODEL": "codex-test-embedding", "EMBEDDING_REVISION": "controlled-baseline-v1",
    "EMBEDDING_DIMENSION": "1024", "SOURCE_DATABASE_PATH": str(DB),
    "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "PYTHONUTF8": "1",
    "HTTP_PROXY": "", "HTTPS_PROXY": "", "ALL_PROXY": "", "NO_PROXY": "*",
}
prefixes = ("OPENAI_", "ANTHROPIC_", "AZURE_", "GEMINI_", "DEEPSEEK_", "DASHSCOPE_",
            "QWEN_", "KEV_", "MEMORY_", "EMBEDDING_", "RETRIEVAL_", "MERCURY_", "LLM_",
            "CERES_V3_")
explicit_remove = {"DATABASE_URL", "SOURCE_DATABASE_PATH", "TEMP", "TMP", "TMPDIR", "PYTHONPATH",
                   "HTTP_PROXY", "HTTPS_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY", "NO_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY", "CERES_TRACE_PATH",
                   "CERES_FAILURE_BOUNDARY_LOG"}


def execute(name: str, nodes: list[str], *, probe: str | None = None) -> dict:
    phase = run_dir / name
    phase.mkdir()
    for d in ("os-temp", "pytest-basetemp", "evidence"):
        (phase / d).mkdir()
    env = os.environ.copy()
    for key in list(env):
        upper = key.upper()
        if upper.startswith(prefixes) or upper in explicit_remove:
            env.pop(key, None)
    values = controlled | {
        "MERCURY_DB_PATH": str(phase / "mercury.sqlite3"),
        "DATABASE_URL": f"sqlite:///{phase / 'unused-default.sqlite3'}",
        "TEMP": str(phase / "os-temp"), "TMP": str(phase / "os-temp"),
        "TMPDIR": str(phase / "os-temp"), "CERES_TRACE_PATH": str(phase / "trace.jsonl"),
    }
    plugin_roots = [str(TRACE_PLUGIN)]
    plugin_args: list[str] = ["-p", "ceres_controlled_trace"]
    if probe:
        plugin_roots.insert(0, str(plugin_dir))
        plugin_args += ["-p", "ceres_failure_inject"]
        values["CERES_FAILURE_BOUNDARY_LOG"] = str(phase / "boundary-attempts.jsonl")
        if probe == "role":
            values["CERES_V3_LIVE_EVIDENCE_DIR"] = str(phase / "evidence")
        else:
            values["CERES_V3_ROUTE_EVIDENCE_DIR"] = str(phase / "evidence")
    env.update(values)
    env["PYTHONPATH"] = os.pathsep.join(plugin_roots)
    argv = [str(PYTHON), "-X", "utf8", "-m", "pytest", "-vv", "--showlocals", "-p", "no:cacheprovider",
            "-W", "error::pytest.PytestUnhandledThreadExceptionWarning", *plugin_args,
            f"--basetemp={phase / 'pytest-basetemp'}", f"--junitxml={phase / 'junit.xml'}", *nodes]
    if probe == "role":
        argv += ["-k", "R01 and not named"]
    (phase / "command.txt").write_text(subprocess.list2cmdline(argv) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    dump(phase / "command.json", {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(BACKEND), "process": "subprocess argv; no shell"})
    dump(phase / "environment.json", {
        "controlled_values": values, "actual_python": str(PYTHON), "python_version": sys.version,
        "pytest_version": __import__("pytest").__version__,
        "openai_version": __import__("importlib.metadata", fromlist=["version"]).version("openai"),
        "httpx_version": __import__("importlib.metadata", fromlist=["version"]).version("httpx"),
        "network_control": "observer probes patch public httpx.Client.send and OpenAI DefaultHttpxClient.send; only testserver non-target API calls pass; target turn stream and every non-testserver send raise controlled ConnectError",
        "retrieval": "RETRIEVAL_INDEX_DIR empty; ordinary client direct DB; indexed_client fixture pairs its lexical index with its isolated DB",
        "source_catalog_sha256": sha(DB),
    })
    before = source_hashes()
    dump(phase / "source-before.json", {"hashes": before, "matches_candidate": before == initial})
    started = time.monotonic()
    with (phase / "stdout.txt").open("wb") as out, (phase / "stderr.txt").open("wb") as err:
        result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=BACKEND, env=env, stdout=out, stderr=err, check=False)
    after = source_hashes()
    cases = []
    junit_error = None
    try:
        root = ET.parse(phase / "junit.xml").getroot()
        for item in root.iter("testcase"):
            outcome, failure = "passed", None
            for child in item:
                if child.tag in ("failure", "error"):
                    outcome, failure = child.tag, {"message": child.attrib.get("message"), "text": child.text}
                elif child.tag == "skipped":
                    outcome = "skipped"
            cases.append({"name": item.attrib.get("name"), "outcome": outcome, "failure": failure})
    except Exception as exc:
        junit_error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
    record = {
        "exit_code": result.returncode, "pid": result.pid if hasattr(result, "pid") else None,
        "duration_seconds": time.monotonic() - started, "selected_node_count": len(nodes),
        "junit_case_count": len(cases), "junit_cases": cases, "junit_parse_error": junit_error,
        "stdout_sha256": sha(phase / "stdout.txt"), "stderr_sha256": sha(phase / "stderr.txt"),
        "source_unchanged": before == after == initial, "source_after_hashes": after,
        "source_catalog_sha256_after": sha(DB),
        "trace_records": sum(1 for _ in (phase / "trace.jsonl").open(encoding="utf-8")) if (phase / "trace.jsonl").exists() else 0,
    }
    dump(phase / "result.json", record)
    print(json.dumps({"phase": name, "path": str(phase), "exit": result.returncode,
                      "junit_cases": len(cases), "source_unchanged": record["source_unchanged"]}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    return record


print(json.dumps({"run_dir": str(run_dir), "preflight": preflight}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)

route_file = run_dir / "probe-route/evidence/results.json"

    "role_recorded_connect_error": bool(role_receipt and role_receipt.get("error_type") == "ConnectError"

    "role_source_sha_matches": bool(role_receipt and role_file.with_suffix(".sha256").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip() == sha(role_file)),
    "route_receipt_exists": route_receipt is not None,
    "route_first_row_failed_with_missing_production_timing": bool(route_receipt and route_receipt["rows"]

        and "ConnectError: controlled recording probe" in route_receipt["rows"][0].get("error", "")),
    "route_requested_rows_incomplete": bool(route_receipt and route_receipt.get("requested_rows") == 22
        and len(route_receipt["rows"]) == 1),
